title: MATLAB for Machine Learning and Deep Learning
description: Hands-on workshop covering ML/DL concepts in MATLAB — from data preprocessing to training neural networks. Ran actual experiments, not just slides.

title: Full Stack Development (MERN)
description: MERN stack certification — MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js. Built a full project during the course, which helped me understand how all four pieces connect.

title: MATLAB Onramp (100%)
description: Completed with a perfect score. Covers numerical computation, data analysis, and MATLAB programming basics. Good foundation before diving into the ML toolbox.

title: Generative AI Workshop
description: Workshop on generative AI architectures, prompt engineering, and LLM applications. The prompt engineering section was particularly useful for my local AI projects.

title: AI Awareness & Foundation
description: AI fundamentals from Intel and Dell — covers ML concepts, computer vision basics, and AI deployment considerations. My first structured intro to AI beyond YouTube tutorials.

title: Digital 101 (Gold)
description: NASSCOM Gold recognition for digital technology skills. Covers core CS concepts — networking, cloud basics, and security fundamentals.

title: Technologies for Clean & Renewable Energy (Elite)
description: NPTEL Elite certification from IIT Roorkee. Not directly related to software, but interesting to understand the engineering behind renewable energy systems.

title: C, C++ Programming & RDBMS PostgreSQL
description: Certified training in C, C++, and PostgreSQL through IIT Bombay's Spoken Tutorial program. These three are still my most-used tools.

title: Cybersecurity Mastery
description: Cybersecurity fundamentals — network security, threat analysis, and secure coding practices. Made me more paranoid about input validation, which is probably a good thing.

title: IEEE Xplore Research Training
description: Learned to navigate IEEE Xplore and academic databases properly. Before this, my research process was basically Google Scholar and hope.
